title: 超越对错：评估大语言模型的二阶社会推理
summary: 本文提出评估大语言模型元规范推理的新框架，从情绪评估和行为反应两个维度出发，并发布包含450个规范违反场景的多视角数据集NormReact。研究发现六个模型普遍高估负面制裁，且随社会距离增加与人类判断的一致性下降，可能导致AI在冲突调解和政策模拟中扭曲社会规范图景。
summary_en: This paper introduces a framework for evaluating metanorm reasoning in LLMs along emotional appraisal and behavioral response dimensions, releasing NormReact, a multi-perspective dataset of 450 norm violation scenarios. Across six models, LLMs overpredict negative sanctions and alignment with human judgments deteriorates as social distance increases, risking distorted social regulation in norm-sensitive AI applications.
